questions.question: The ratio of selling price to the cost price is 9 ∶ 8. What is the profit percentage?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Selling price (S.P) : Cost price (C.P) = 9 : 8

**Formula used:**

Profit% = {(S.P - C.P) × 100}/C.P

**Calculation:**

Profit% = {(S.P - C.P) × 100}/C.P

⇒ {(9 - 8) × 100}/8

⇒ {1 × 100}/8 = 12.5%

**∴ The correct answer is 12.5%.**

questions.question: The sum of the two numbers is 45. Their HCF And LCM are 5 and 70 respectively. Find the sum of the reciprocal of the two numbers.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Sum of two numbers = 45

H.C.F = 5 ; L.C.M = 70

**Formula used:**

Product of numbers = H.C.F × L.C.M

Sum of reciprocal = (sum of numbers/product of numbers)

**Calculation:**

Sum of reciprocal = (sum of numbers/product of numbers)

⇒ 45/(5 × 70) = 9/70

**∴ The correct answer is 9/70.**

questions.question: The sum of the length and breadth of a cuboid is 16 cm. If the height of the cuboid is 1/4 of the sum of its length and breadth, then what is the lateral surface area of the cuboid?
questions.solution:
Given:

The sum of the length and breadth of a cuboid is 16 cm.

The height of the cuboid is 1/4 of the sum of its length and breadth.

Formula used:

The lateral surface area of a cuboid = 2 ×(l+b) × h

(l = length, b = breadth , h = height)

Calculation: 

Height of the cuboid will be

⇒ 1 / 4 × 16 = 4 cm

Lateral surface area will be,

⇒ 2 ×(l+b) × h = 2 ×16 × 4

⇒ 128 cm2

**∴ The correct option is 1**

questions.question: Simple interest on a sum for eight months at the rate of 8 percent per annum is Rs. 240. What is the value of sum?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Effective interest rate for 8 months = 8 × (8 ÷ 12) = 16/3%

As per the question, (16/3)% of Sum = 240

1% of Sum = (240 × 3) ÷ 16 = 45

100% of Sum = 45 × 100 = 4500

**∴ The correct answer is ₹4500.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Simple Interest (SI) = ₹240

Rate (R) = 8% per annum

Time (T) = 8 months = 8 ÷ 12 = 2/3 years

**Formula Used:**

SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3001218e0d1d066e9605cbecfac6d5c89364ef5509afcf5e52c11bb3bafbcb79.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 240 = [P × 8 × (2 ÷ 3)] ÷ 100

⇒ 240 = (P × 16) ÷ 300

⇒ P = (240 × 300) ÷ 16

⇒ P = 15 × 300

⇒ P = 4500

**∴ The correct answer is ₹4500.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Amount Formula

The total amount (A) at the end of the time period is given by: A = P + SI, where P is the Principal and SI is the Simple Interest.

Effective Interest Rate

The overall interest rate accumulated over T years is simply (R × T)%. So, SI = (R × T)% of Principal.

Time Conversion

When time is given in months, divide by 12 to convert it to years (e.g., 8 months = 8 ÷ 12 years). If given in days, divide by 365.

Difference Between SI and CI

In Simple Interest, the principal remains constant. In Compound Interest (CI), interest is calculated on both the initial principal and the accumulated interest.

questions.solution:

P and Q start from the same point and at the same time with speeds 20 km/hr and 16 km/hr respectively

Concept used:

The Relative speed in the same direction is = Greater speed - Smaller speed 

Distance = speed × time 

Calculation:

The Relative speed in the same direction is ,

⇒ (20 -16) km/hr = 4km / hr

So distance travelled in 4 hr is,

⇒ 4 × 4 = 16 km

∴ The correct option is 4

So the quantity of alcohol

questions.question: The compound interest (compounding annually) on a certain sum for 2 years at the rate of 20 percent per annum is Rs.2420. What will be the simple interest on the same sum for 3 years at the same rate of interest?
questions.solution:
Given:

The compound interest for 2 years = Rs 2420

Time = 2 year

Rate = 20%

Formula used:

Compound interest = [Principal × [1 + r/100]ⁿ] - Principal

where n is time

Calculation:

Le the Principal be P.

Compound interest = [P × [1 + 20/100]²] - P

Compound interest = [P × [1 + 1/5]2] - P

Compound interest = [P × [6/5]2] - P

Compound interest = [P × 36/25] - P

⇒ 2420 = (36P - 25P)/25

⇒ 2420 = 11P/25

⇒ P = 220 × 25

⇒ P = 5500

Now the the simple interest on the same sum for 3 years at the same rate of interest will be:

Simple interest = (5500 × 20 × 3)/100

**Simple interest = 3300**

The ratio of the radius of two spheres

The ratio of the volume of the two spheres

questions.question: If P ∶ Q ∶ R = 4 ∶ 7 ∶ 9 and R ∶ S = 2 ∶ 5, then what is the value of P ∶ S?
questions.solution:
**Given:-**

P ∶ Q ∶ R = 4 ∶ 7 ∶ 9, and R ∶ S = 2 ∶ 5 

**Calculation:-**

We have to equal unit of R in both the ratio

P ∶ Q ∶ R = 4 ∶ 7 ∶ 9 [ multiply by 2, we get ]

⇒ P ∶ Q ∶ R = 8 ∶ 14 ∶ 18

 

 Similarly,

⇒ R ∶ S = 2 ∶ 5 [ multiply by 9, we get ]

⇒ R: S = 18 : 45

Now,

⇒ P ∶ Q ∶ R ∶ S = 8 ∶ 14 ∶ 18 ∶ 45

∴ P ∶ S = 8 ∶ 45 

**∴ The required answer is__ 8 ∶ 45.__**

questions.question: Sunil drove for 2 hours at a rate of 50 miles per hour and for 3 hours at 60 miles per hour. What was his average speed for the whole journey?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Sunil drove 2 hours at rate of 50 miles per hours

Sunil drove 3 hours at rate of 60 miles per hours

**Concept:**

Average speed={Total distanceover Total time}

**Formula used:**

S={Dover T} Where, S = Speed, D = Distance, and T = Time

**Calculation:**

Let the average speed of the Sunil be S

The distance travel by Sunil in first travel = 2 × 50 = 100 miles

The distance traveled by Sunil in second travel = 3 × 60 = 180 miles

The total time = 2 + 3 = 5

The average speed S = {280over5}=56 miles per hours

**∴ The required result will be 56 miles per hours.**
